stage_table.unit: bytes, symbols and types handed to the decompiler
stage_table.detail: provider.rs answers every query the C++ makes for bytes, symbols, types and flow facts; C++ loader lines executed: 2351 vendored (storage of what it is given)

stage_table.unit: stored analysis facts (xrefs, data definitions, flow overrides) by provenance
stage_table.detail: sampled functions by producer: {'call': 172, 'const': 4, 'pattern': 108, 'flow': 115, 'thunk': 1} (all Rust passes); constant-propagation facts are computed in process (native_runtime/propagation); facts owned by C++: 0 of 743641. Import time in C++-owned phases: 25.6%

stage_table.unit: flow queries during the discovery walk
stage_table.detail: discovery.rs walks with the in-process kuna-sleigh decoder (`SleighFlow`), and the constant propagation follows flow over the same decoder (native_runtime/propagation/graph.rs, FlowInfo); no C++ answers flow during import

stage_table.unit: instructions followed into the function body and its blocks
stage_table.detail: the decompiler's own FlowInfo (flow.cc) builds the function's p-code and block graph on every decompile; vendored flow lines executed 762

stage_table.unit: instructions lifted on the printed path
stage_table.detail: 20618 instructions in the sampled functions are lifted by the decompiler's own SLEIGH (ghidra_opt, ROMWRIGHT_SLA). Rust-lifted p-code (kuna-sleigh) feeds value-set analysis, SJA, the type solver and the prototype job, never the printed text

stage_table.unit: dispatches in the stored import tables
stage_table.detail: 2107 of 2545 dispatches (84.0% of case edges) by Rust VSA; the rest by the decompiler path (a branch the decompiler-off import also stores is Rust's)

stage_table.unit: switch tables the decompiler used when printing
stage_table.detail: 13 printed tables in 400 functions; the import's stored table was the authority for 13 (100.0%): 12 agreed with what jumptable.cc recovers again at decompile time, 1 replaced it; 0 had no stored table. Of the supplied tables 10 are Rust VSA's (the rest are the import's own decompiler pass, jumptable.cc at import time); jumptable.cc still derives the normalization, guards and case values. Of the sample's 9 Rust-recovered dispatches 9 also printed as a switch
290 Rust edits (290 additive_inverse, 0 canonical_helpers) over 40769 operations; 66 of 400 functions have an edit

2655 type tokens; the default import stores no persisted prototype, so every printed type is Ghidra's. The Rust type solver still runs per function as an evidence pass whose classes only steer export-c's temporary and global names
0 of 400 printed functions had a stored prototype; 0 of 1278 call sites name a callee with one (type-archive and SDK tables, Rust)
